milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the brown wool structure and face it to demonstrate they have located it. Target is the volumetric center of the brown wool tower at (4, 2, 4), which spans X=3-5, Y=0-4, Z=3-5. max_distance=16 is generous since the wool is only ~5-7 blocks from spawn and clearly visible. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the orange bed and face it to demonstrate they have located it. Target is the center of the orange bed at (5, 0.5, 6.5), using Y=0.5 to account for the bed surface being slightly above ground level (CommonSenseAgent recommendation). The bed spans X=5, Y=0, Z=6-7 so (5, 0.5, 6.5) is the visual center. max_distance=16 allows detection from moderate range. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is oriented toward the bed, not just nearby.
